clue.text: He's a fool to obstruct the chief

parts.note: to block a road is to obstruct it
the head is the chief or leader

explanation.surface: A dimwit is someone who stands in the boss's way.
explanation.definitionFit: A blockhead is a stupid person, a dolt.

clue.text: The French member has nothing on in the satire

parts.note: la is the French feminine word for the
MP is a Member of Parliament
O looks like zero, nothing
taken as written

explanation.surface: A French politician appears naked in a comic sketch.
explanation.definitionFit: A lampoon is a piece of mocking ridicule aimed at a person.

clue.text: Company sluggish up to a point fraudulently conspire

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: dull means slow and sluggish
E for east, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A slow firm that, up to a certain moment, plotted to cheat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns DULL into LLUD; 'to' is a link, and 'a point' is a compass point.
explanation.definitionFit: To collude is to cooperate secretly to deceive or cheat.

clue.text: Hear, say, of a crossing place on the Wye

indicators.note: say signals the word is spoken and written as a word that sounds the same

parts.note: hear sounds just like here
a ford is a shallow place to cross a river

explanation.surface: Listen to tales of a river crossing on a Welsh border river.
explanation.walkthrough: The Wye is a river on the England-Wales border; the cathedral city of Hereford stands on it.
explanation.definitionFit: Hereford is the English city through which the River Wye flows.

clue.text: Representative in a foreign gov, ernment

definitions.text: Representative in a foreign gov, ernment

parts.words: Representative in a foreign gov, ernment
parts.note: describes an elected member of an assembly such as the French chamber

explanation.walkthrough: The comma in 'gov, ernment' is a printing break in the word government.
explanation.definitionFit: In France and elsewhere a member of the lower parliamentary chamber is called by this title.

clue.text: He has the letter coming to him

definitions.text: He has the letter coming to him

parts.words: He has the letter coming to him
parts.note: sounds like someone due a punishment, but is just the person to whom post is sent

explanation.definitionFit: The person a letter is directed to is the one named on its envelope.

clue.text: Army equipment packed for a journey

definitions.text: Army equipment packed for a journey

parts.words: Army equipment packed for a journey
parts.note: describes the portable kit of a marching army, and luggage generally

explanation.definitionFit: Baggage is luggage, and historically the portable equipment carried by an army on the move.

clue.text: Willing female

parts.note: suggests an eager woman, but willing here means making a will

explanation.definitionFit: A woman who has made a will is the legal feminine form for its maker.

clue.text: Checkmate?

parts.note: the move that finishes a chess game belongs to its closing stage

explanation.definitionFit: Checkmate happens in the final phase of a chess game, the stage after the middle game.

clue.text: Child learning to beg

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child
lore is traditional knowledge or learning

explanation.surface: A schoolchild is being taught how to plead.
explanation.definitionFit: To implore is to plead or entreat earnestly.

clue.text: Just a piano

definitions.meaning: just in the sense of honest and fair
a piano with a vertical frame, as opposed to a grand

explanation.definitionFit: An honest person is called upright, and the tall vertical piano is known by the same name.

clue.text: Cheese, gold-backed that in France is for tea, say

indicators.note: backed means the word for gold is written backwards

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
que is French for that
taken as written

indicators.note: say signals that the word tea is spoken and its sound written as a letter

parts.note: the drink tea, which sounds like the letter T

explanation.surface: A recipe note that sounds like French menu talk about a cheese served at teatime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gold-backed' turns OR into RO; 'tea, say' gives T by sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Roquefort is a French blue cheese made from ewe's milk.

clue.text: Acknowledged that the salesman was dishonest

parts.note: rep is short for sales representative
lied means told untruths

explanation.surface: Admitting that the travelling salesman told fibs.
explanation.definitionFit: To have replied is to have answered or acknowledged a message.

clue.text: Ability to see a word of agreement in 8

indicators.note: in tells us the agreeing word is put inside the number

parts.note: the figure eight written as a word
yes is a word saying you agree

explanation.surface: A puzzle about spotting an affirmative tucked into a number.
explanation.walkthrough: '8' stands for the number written as a word, a convention of cross-referencing clues; the agreeing word sits after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyesight is the faculty of vision.

clue.text: Some intend earnestly to charm

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people sincerely mean to win others over.
explanation.definitionFit: To endear is to make someone liked, to win affection.

clue.text: I wondered about a cover for the bed

indicators.note: about here means turned around, so the letters are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: Musing on a bedspread.
explanation.definitionFit: An eiderdown is a quilt filled with duck down, laid on a bed.

clue.text: Like some engines, not warm although having been dried out

indicators.note: having means holding, so one word sits inside the other

parts.note: aired means dried out in the open air
cool means not warm

explanation.surface: Something left out to dry yet still not warm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'although' is only a link; the surface makes 'not warm' and 'dried out' sound like a contrast, but one simply sits inside the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Some motors, such as old Volkswagen and motorcycle ones, use air flow rather than water to stay at temperature.

clue.text: Make a semblance of fancy doilies

indicators.note: fancy here is an adjective meaning elaborate, so the letters are arranged elaborately anew

explanation.surface: Copying ornate lace table mats.
explanation.walkthrough: To idolise is literally to make an idol, an image or semblance, of someone.
explanation.definitionFit: An idol is an image or likeness, so to worship someone as one is to make an image of them.

clue.text: Scout perhaps in the ship runs about playfully

indicators.note: in tells us the scout word sits inside the ship letters

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
a Scout, who camps out, is an example of a camper

explanation.surface: A Boy Scout aboard a vessel dashes about in high spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: To scamper is to run quickly and playfully, like a child or small animal.

clue.text: Weekly payment for a boarding house

definitions.meaning: a regular state or retirement payment
a small continental hotel offering board

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a retirement allowance and, in the French sense, a guesthouse.

clue.text: Rex and Victor shortly break neck

indicators.note: break suggests the letters are smashed and put back together
shortly means the name is cut short to its familiar form

parts.note: Victor is shortened to Vic

explanation.surface: Two men named Rex and Victor are about to snap someone's neck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortly' cuts VICTOR to VIC; 'break' rearranges REX and VIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Cervix is the Latin anatomical term for a neck, as in the neck of the womb.

clue.text: Not a well-cooked portion of a toasted snack

parts.note: rare meat is lightly cooked, not well done
a bit is a portion or piece

explanation.surface: An underdone piece of cheese on toast.
explanation.walkthrough: Welsh rarebit is a British dish of melted cheese on toast.
explanation.definitionFit: Welsh rarebit is a dish of melted cheese sauce on toasted bread.

clue.text: Progressing between stations?

parts.note: a passenger riding the railway between stops, and the phrase for something under way

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means under way or in progress, and literally describes riding a railway carriage.

clue.text: Drill practice

definitions.meaning: a drill is a training routine

explanation.definitionFit: Exercise means both a training drill and repeated practice of a skill.

clue.text: Tyrant has Sparta in turmoil

indicators.note: in turmoil means in confusion, so the city's letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: A despot has thrown an ancient Greek city into chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: A satrap was a Persian provincial governor, and the word now means a despotic subordinate ruler.

clue.text: Overshadow a silent reproof

parts.note: dumb means unable or unwilling to speak
to rate is an old word for to scold or reprove

explanation.surface: A quiet rebuke that puts someone in the shade.
explanation.walkthrough: RATE, meaning to scold, is an old-fashioned usage.
explanation.definitionFit: To adumbrate is to foreshadow or overshadow, to cast a shadow over.

clue.text: Little girl's wrong to misrepresent the facts

parts.note: Di is a short name for a girl, here with its possessive s
a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: It is naughty of a little girl to twist the truth.
explanation.definitionFit: To distort is to twist or falsify an account.

clue.text: Barns i.e. custom-built for one from Southern Europe

indicators.note: something custom-built is constructed to order, so the letters are assembled into a new shape

explanation.surface: Bespoke farm buildings made for a Balkan client.
explanation.definitionFit: A Serbian is a native of Serbia in the Balkans.

clue.text: A room we converted in Australia

indicators.note: converted describes a room changed into something else, so its letters change order

explanation.surface: We did up a room while living Down Under.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description: Woomera is a town and rocket range in South Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: Woomera is a township and weapons-testing site in South Australia.

clue.text: Beating up badly and slating mercilessly

indicators.note: badly suggests the little word is jumbled
mercilessly suggests the criticism word is roughed up into a new order

explanation.surface: A critic savaging a performance, giving it a severe drubbing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' turns UP into PU; 'mercilessly' rearranges SLATING as LSATING.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulsating means throbbing rhythmically, as a heart beats.
